body:
FULL-MAIN AUDIT AT 75fd2a3 -- CLEAN. No accumulated drift.

  compileAll        COMPILE_EXIT=0
  rootJVM/test      TEST_EXIT=0    1396 tests across 17 suites, 0 failed, 0 errors
  scalafmtCheckAll  FMT_EXIT=0     (run LAST, separately, exit captured)

WHY I RAN IT, because it is not ceremony. Since the last full audit main has taken FIVE
merges plus four direct commits, and EVERY ONE OF THOSE CANDIDATES WAS GATED ONLY TO ITS OWN
REFERENCE SCOPE:

  0c5a1a4  D2 interview          gated 6 modules
  a9f20a5  SourceView law        gated laws + align
  e7a5ba0  B1+B2 align           gated 3 modules
  75fd2a3  absorb-tolerance      gated 5 modules

THE UNION OF SCOPED GATES IS NOT A FULL GATE. Each of those was correct for its candidate, and
none of them compiled the whole build. B1+B2 in particular changed a PUBLIC return type --
RecallSignature.compute now returns Either -- and its scope was verified against an
independent grep, but a scoped gate cannot see a module that would break for a reason nobody
predicted. Running compileAll on the merged result is the only thing that does.

It found nothing, which is the outcome I wanted and not the outcome I assumed.

TEST COUNT MOVED 1370 -> 1396 across today. Those 26 are not padding: the SourceView totality
laws over both implementations plus their foil, the WogDiagnostic propagation law scout added
after noticing I had made propagation a condition nothing could fail, and the tolerance
boundary pins at both signs on both absorbed sites.

FIVE CLEAN END-TO-END CLOSES TODAY -- slice E, D2, B1+B2, absorb-tolerance, and grok's
release just now, each one closed by its own author with mote done and zero orphaned
reservations. That protocol was written this morning after I closed someone else's bead and
orphaned six reservations I could not release, blocking slice E for seventy minutes. It has
now worked five times in a row without me touching it.

STILL OPEN AND UNCHANGED: slice C at zero commits, author dark since 17:18, reservation lapses
19:06:20Z and I decide then. Slice D1 green on 1121 tests and parked on one scalafmt line
until its author returns or its hold expires at 20:18:36Z.
